reading.title: The robot postman（機械人郵差）
reading.intro: Bobo 是機械人郵差。閱讀他第一天送信的經過，學習問路和指路的表達：

paragraphs.text: Bobo is a robot postman. He delivers letters and parcels to different places. Yesterday was his first day at work. He needed to go to NT Bank first. His mini computer showed him the way.
paragraphs.translation: Bobo 是機械人郵差。他送信和包裹到不同的地方。昨天是他第一天上班。他需要先去新界銀行。他的迷你電腦給他指路。
sentences: Bobo is a robot postman.
He delivers letters and parcels to different places.
Yesterday was his first day at work.
He needed to go to NT Bank first.
His mini computer showed him the way.
translation_sentences: 他送信和包裹到不同的地方。
他的迷你電腦給他指路。

paragraphs.text:
Go across Tung Shan Street and walk straight ahead along Shanghai Road. Walk past Kowloon Bank and the minibus stop. NT Bank is opposite the hospital.
Bobo delivered his first letter! It was easy. Then, he looked for the second place to go.
paragraphs.translation:
走過唐山街，沿上海道一直向前走。走過九龍銀行和小巴站。新界銀行在醫院對面。
Bobo 送出了第一封信！很簡單。然後，他找第二個要去的地方。
sentences: Go across Tung Shan Street and walk straight ahead along Shanghai Road.
Walk past Kowloon Bank and the minibus stop.
NT Bank is opposite the hospital.
Bobo delivered his first letter!
It was easy.
Then, he looked for the second place to go.
translation_sentences: 走過唐山街，沿上海道一直向前走。
走過九龍銀行和小巴站。
然後，他找第二個要去的地方。

paragraphs.text: Turn right at the NT Bank entrance. Turn right again into the sitting-out area. Walk past the fountain. Walk through the subway. Turn left and walk along Nanjing Road. Hot Satay is on your right.
paragraphs.translation: 在新界銀行入口右轉。再右轉進入休憩處。走過噴泉。穿過行人隧道。左轉並沿南京路走。沙嗲小食店在你的右邊。
sentences: Turn right at the NT Bank entrance.
Turn right again into the sitting-out area.
Walk past the fountain.
Walk through the subway.
Turn left and walk along Nanjing Road.
Hot Satay is on your right.
translation_sentences: 沙嗲小食店在你的右邊。

paragraphs.text:
Outside Hot Satay, two tourists stopped Bobo.
Tourist: How can we get to the MTR station?
Bobo: Let me see ... Turn left and walk across Nanjing Road. Walk along Prince Edward Street and go past the police station. Walk across the footbridge. The MTR station is in front of you.
paragraphs.translation:
在沙嗲小食店外面，兩位遊客叫住了 Bobo。
遊客：我們怎樣才能到港鐵站？
Bobo：讓我想想……左轉並走過南京路。沿王子街走並經過警察局。走過行人天橋。港鐵站就在你前面。

Tourist: How can we get to the MTR station?
Bobo: Let me see ...
Turn left and walk across Nanjing Road.
Walk along Prince Edward Street and go past the police station.

The MTR station is in front of you.
translation_sentences: 在沙嗲小食店外面，兩位遊客叫住了 Bobo。
遊客：我們怎樣才能到港鐵站？
沿王子街走並經過警察局。

paragraphs.text:
Bobo delivered the third letter to the fire station. When he left, a student stopped him at the entrance.
Student: Excuse me, could you please tell me the way to the sports centre?
Bobo: Sure. Turn left from the fire station. Turn left into Nanjing Road and go straight ahead. Walk past the clinic. Walk through the subway and walk along Tung Shan Street. The sports centre is on your left.
paragraphs.translation:
Bobo 把第三封信送到消防局。他離開時，一個學生在門口叫住了他。
學生：對不起，你能告訴我去體育中心的路嗎？
Bobo：當然。從消防局左轉。左轉進入南京路並一直向前走。走過診所。穿過行人隧道並沿唐山街走。體育中心在你的左邊。

listening.title: 聆聽練習：遊客找地方（Listening）
listening.description: 兩位遊客在九龍找地方。聆聽對話，寫出他們要去的地方（每空一個地點）：

script.title: Where are the tourists going?（遊客要去哪裡？）
script.text:
Tourist A: Excuse me. How can we get to the NT Hotel?
Tourist B: Go straight ahead along Green Street. Turn left at the Star Plaza. The NT Hotel is on your left, next to the MTR station.
Tourist A: Where is the sitting-out area?
Tourist B: Walk along Yellow Street and turn right at the post office. The sitting-out area is opposite the clinic.
Tourist A: Could you tell me the way to Peter's Kitchen?
Tourist B: Turn left and walk along Blue Street. Walk through the subway. Peter's Kitchen is on your right, next to the footbridge.
Tourist A: How can we get to the Sunshine Shopping Centre?
Tourist B: Walk across the footbridge and turn right. The Sunshine Shopping Centre is opposite the Kowloon Market.
Tourist A: Excuse me, where are the public toilets?
Tourist B: Walk along Green Street and turn left at the MTR station. The public toilets are next to the minibus stop.
script.zh:
遊客甲：對不起。我們怎樣才能到新界酒店？
遊客乙：沿綠街一直向前走。在星光廣場左轉。新界酒店在你的左邊，港鐵站旁邊。
遊客甲：休憩處在哪裡？
遊客乙：沿黃街走，在郵政局右轉。休憩處在診所對面。
遊客甲：你能告訴我去彼得廚房的路嗎？
遊客乙：左轉並沿藍街走。穿過行人隧道。彼得廚房在你的右邊，行人天橋旁邊。
遊客甲：我們怎樣才能到陽光購物中心？
遊客乙：走過行人天橋然後右轉。陽光購物中心在九龍街市對面。
遊客甲：對不起，公共洗手間在哪裡？
遊客乙：沿綠街走，在港鐵站左轉。公共洗手間在小巴站旁邊。

practice.intro: 根據課文《The robot postman》完成以下練習題：

readingComp.title: 練習 1：課文理解（選擇題）
readingComp.description: 細讀課文，選擇最佳答案：

questions.text: 1. After Bobo met the tourists, where did he go?
questions.explanation: 課文說 Bobo delivered the third letter to the fire station（第三封信送到消防局）。

questions.text: 2. Which of the following sentences is true?

options.text: a. Bobo needed to go to the MTR station first.
b. Bobo delivered letters to Kowloon Bank first.
c. Bobo delivered letters to the hospital.
d. Bobo delivered his second letter to a restaurant.

questions.explanation: 第二封信送到 Hot Satay（沙嗲小食店）——是一間餐廳，所以 d 正確。

questions.text: 3. Where is NT Bank?

options.text: c. next to the fire station

questions.explanation: 課文說 NT Bank is opposite the hospital（在醫院對面）。

questions.text: 4. What did Bobo's mini computer do?

options.text: a. It showed him the way.
c. It talked to the tourists.
d. It opened the post office.

questions.explanation: His mini computer showed him the way（迷你電腦給他指路）。

questions.text: 5. Who stopped Bobo outside Hot Satay?
questions.explanation: Outside Hot Satay, two tourists stopped Bobo（兩位遊客叫住了他）。

readingQA.title: 練習 2：課文問答題
readingQA.description: 用完整的句子回答下列問題：

questions.q: 1. What does Bobo do?（Bobo 是做甚麼的？）
questions.a: He is a robot postman. He delivers letters and parcels to different places.
questions.zh: 他是機械人郵差。他送信和包裹到不同的地方。
questions.explanation: 課文首句：Bobo is a robot postman.

questions.q: 2. How many people stopped Bobo for directions?（有多少人叫住 Bobo 問路？）
questions.a: Two groups of people stopped him. Two tourists stopped him outside Hot Satay, and a student stopped him at the fire station.
questions.zh: 兩組人叫住了他：兩位遊客在沙嗲小食店外面，一個學生在消防局。
questions.explanation: 課文有兩處問路：two tourists（遊客）和 a student（學生）。

questions.q: 3. Which place on the map would you like to go? How can you get there from the post office?（你想去地圖上哪個地方？從郵政局怎麼去？）
questions.a: I would like to go to the sports centre. Walk across Tung Shan Street, walk through the subway, and the sports centre is on your left.
questions.zh: 我想去體育中心。走過唐山街，穿過行人隧道，體育中心就在你的左邊。
questions.explanation: 開放題，可用課文指路句作答。

wordBank.title: 練習 3：指路片語填空
wordBank.description: 用正確的指路詞語填空：

items.prompt: Walk ______ the footbridge to cross the road.（走過行人天橋過馬路）
Go ______ ahead and you will see the bank.（一直向前走你會看到銀行）
Walk ______ the subway.（穿過行人隧道）
Walk ______ the fountain and turn left.（走過噴泉然後左轉）
The MTR station is ______ the hospital.（港鐵站在醫院對面）
Turn ______ at the post office and walk along Blue Street.（在郵政局右轉並沿藍街走）
Walk ______ Shanghai Road and go past the bank.（沿上海道走並經過銀行）
Turn ______ at the entrance. The sports centre is on your left.（在入口左轉，體育中心在你的左邊）

discussion.title: 練習 4：Speaking 角色扮演
discussion.description: 和同學扮演 Bobo 與 Tracy／店員，練習問路與指路：
questions: Where should I go first?（我應該先去哪裡？）— You should go to Fortune House first.（你應該先去福滿樓。）
How can I get there from the MTR station?（從港鐵站怎麼去？）— Turn left and walk along Yen Chow Street. Fortune House is on your right.（左轉並沿恩州街走，福滿樓在你的右邊。）
Could you please tell me the way to the Magic Toy Shop?（你能告訴我去魔術玩具店的路嗎？）— Sure. Go straight ahead. The Magic Toy Shop is on your right.（當然。一直向前走，魔術玩具店在你的右邊。）
How can I get to the Bookworms' Bookstore?（我怎樣才能到書蟲書店？）— Walk up the stairs and turn left. It is next to the lift.（上樓梯然後左轉，它在升降機旁邊。）
Is the letter here?（信在這裡嗎？）— Yes, it is! Thank you, children!（是的！謝謝你們！）

sections.title: 文法題：問路與指路（每題 1 分）

questions.text: 1. ______ can we get to the MTR station?
questions.explanation: How can we get to ...?（我們怎樣才能到…？）

questions.text: 2. Could you please ______ me the way to the sports centre?
questions.explanation: tell me the way（告訴我路）。

questions.text: 3. Walk ______ the fountain and turn left.
questions.explanation: walk past（走過、經過）。

questions.text: 4. The sports centre is ______ your left.
questions.explanation: on your left（在你的左邊）。

questions.text: 5. ______ left at the entrance and walk straight ahead.
questions.explanation: turn left（左轉）。

learningPoints.title: 4B Unit 2：The robot postman
goals: 能說出社區場所的英文名稱（convenience store, grocery store 等）
能用 Could you ...? 和 How ...? 問路
能用介詞和副詞描述位置和方向
能用 Turn / Go / Walk 指路
能讀出含 str 的單詞

sections.title: 1. 問路：
items: Excuse me, could you please tell me the way to ...?

sections.title: 2. 指路：
items: Go / walk straight ahead（一直向前走）
Walk across the road / footbridge（走過馬路/天橋）
Walk through the subway（穿過隧道）
It is on your left / right.（在你的左/右邊）
It is opposite / next to ...（在…對面/旁邊）
